en: The board normally has 21 trustees: 7 Class A (non-alcoholic) and 14 Class B (A.A. members). A Class B chair is added as an extra voting Class B trustee, so there are 22 while Scott H., the first Class B chair, serves his four-year term (spring 2024 to spring 2028). If the next chair is Class A, the board goes back to 21.
es: La Junta suele tener 21 custodios: 7 de clase A (no alcohólicos) y 14 de clase B (miembros de A.A.). Un presidente de clase B se suma como custodio adicional de clase B con voto, así que hay 22 mientras Scott H., el primer presidente de clase B, cumple su período de cuatro años (de la primavera de 2024 a la de 2028). Si el próximo presidente es de clase A, la Junta vuelve a tener 21.
notes: Shown on About (the triangle's General Service Board line) and on How service works. UPDATE IN SPRING 2028 when the next chair takes office (also: about.tri.gsb in content.csv, service.structure.gsb_what in service.csv, and the General Service Board and trustee rows of data/glossary.csv). Source: A.A. Service Manual / GSB bylaws; Scott H. took office after the 74th GSC (2024), term through the annual meeting after the 78th GSC (2028). Name: first name and last initial only.
